$comment: The repository toolchain file of coai v2 (epoch 3 E2, story s1): .coai/toolchain.yaml, which wins over detection (server.md § 12). `coai-mcp` reads it with the strict YAML subset reader (src_mcp/core/Toolchain/ToolchainFile.cs, tables in ToolchainTables.cs); there is no JSON Schema engine in either half, so a test (AToolchainSchemaAgreesWithTheReaderTests) holds this file and the tables equal. The strict subset has block lists and block maps and no flow list but `[]`: a command is written one argv item to a line. An argv is started WITHOUT a shell, from the repository root, with a minimal environment; `{jobs}` is replaced by the number of build workers; a secret never goes in argv (the reader refuses text that looks like one). `path` names the project folder; an argv path is relative to the repository root. A command the file does not name is left to the adapter's default ONLY for a project that states no command at all (SPEC A2 of epoch 3 E4): a project that states `build`, `test`, `restore`, `format` or `testFor` is run exactly as written and only its stated steps run, and a project with `path` and `adapter` alone gets the defaults of its own folder, read at the base commit. `skip` of `restore` or `format` takes that step out of a defaulted project. `restore` and `format` and `testFor` are argv lists like `build`; `testFiles` lists folder prefixes inside the project that hold test files, and `testFor` needs it. In `format` an item `{file}` is replaced by one item per changed file (written `./<path>`); in `testFor` `{file}` or `{stem}` is an item of its own and becomes one item per changed file (a longer item that holds one is refused); `{jobs}` may appear in any command and no other placeholder is accepted. `[]` says there is no such step. `build` and `test` cannot be skipped: a file that skips them would be green having checked nothing. A timeout is a whole number and a unit (s, m, h) of at most 24 hours; the defaults are 15m for a build step and 30m for a test step. The optional `instructions` key (epoch 3 E3 s7 t3) declares ONE step coai runs before a coder job's turn 0, in a check unit at the base commit: `argv` (run with no shell), `perFile` (appended once for each file of the task; an item may hold {file}, and {file} is refused in `argv`) and `timeoutSeconds` (1 to 300, 60 when absent); coai never reads an instruction file to find a command.
